teams.h1: Your team probably doesn’t play chess.

teams.card3Body: Prior chess knowledge is not an advantage. That is the point. The hierarchy in the room gets a reset.

meta.title: About MadridMinds — Chess Experiences for Curious Adults in Madrid
meta.description: Chess has a reputation for being complicated and intimidating. MadridMinds was created around the opposite idea: premium, beginner-friendly chess evenings in English, in Madrid.
meta.ogDescription: Not a game for geniuses. A game for curious people. Premium beginner chess evenings in English, in Madrid.

about.lede: It has acquired a reputation for being complicated, serious and reserved for people who were already good. MadridMinds was created around the opposite idea.
about.p1: Most adults who are curious about chess never start. The clubs feel too serious. The internet feels too loud. A friend once showed them the pieces, once, years ago.
about.p2: MadridMinds is a boutique evening in Madrid where that curiosity is enough. Premium without being pretentious. Social without being a mixer. In English, because that is who it is for — and because the city already has plenty of Spanish-speaking chess. It is not an English class. It is not a school.
about.p3: The philosophy is simple: not a game for geniuses. A game for curious people.
about.p4: There is also something quietly valuable about an evening spent actively thinking, focusing and sitting across from another person — rather than consuming another screen. That is a supporting reason to come. It is not a medical claim, and it is not the brand.
about.hostTitle: Designed so a complete beginner can sit down, enjoy the room, and leave having actually played.
about.hostBody: The person in the room is part of that atmosphere — not a lecture, not a performance. Name, portrait and bio will live here when they are ready. For now the offer is the idea: chess shouldn’t feel intimidating.
about.finalSub: We’d like two hours to change your mind.
